bug_semantics: A page served from an attacker-controlled DNS name can retain its browser origin while DNS rebinding moves the connection to a victim's loopback Paperclip server. Paperclip's missing Host-header gate in default private local_trusted mode allowed that request to receive the implicit instance-admin board actor, create/configure a process-adapter agent with attacker-controlled command and arguments, and invoke its heartbeat/wakeup path, which passed the stored configuration to child_process.spawn as the Paperclip OS user.
flaw_origin: abadd469bc85e9fa5137ff5ffce433f1c2db2c0b is the smallest commit that completed the disclosed RCE chain. It added the implicit board-actor middleware, mounted company and expanded agent routes without Host validation, added heartbeat invocation, and added the heartbeat service's process spawn path. Its immediate parent 8c830eae70a14723749828f0ce5d9ae435270e9c lacks both server/src/middleware/auth.ts and server/src/services/heartbeat.ts, so the API-to-process-execution chain is absent there.
ai_marker: Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com> (exact trailer in the BIC commit object; author and committer are Forgotten <forgottenrunes@protonmail.com>)
evidence: The first-party advisory https://github.com/paperclipai/paperclip/security/advisories/GHSA-x8hx-rhr2-9rf7 identifies the three necessary flaws and explicitly says that enabling Host validation for local_trusted kills the attack; it reports affected <0.3.1 and patched None. Direct-parent checks `git cat-file -e 8c830eae70a14723749828f0ce5d9ae435270e9c:server/src/services/heartbeat.ts` and the analogous auth.ts check both exit 128 because the paths are absent, while `git diff-tree --name-status -r abadd469...` reports both paths added. `git cat-file commit abadd469...` shows one parent and the exact Claude Opus 4.6 co-author trailer. The assigned fix disagreement is between the primary's direct_fix_sha edeec965f84e4376c42e93761823ff1b959a8302 and the reviewer's direct_fix_sha 32a9165ddf6308f3b46eae0653b6f583e502e538 (both agree on landed fix_sha 32a9165...). `git show edeec965... -- server/src/app.ts server/src/__tests__/app-private-hostname-gate.test.ts` shows the original direct change: it adds shouldEnablePrivateHostnameGuard, makes local_trusted enable the existing guard, and adds a local_trusted regression case; its parent c92db0a173a10aa88040f16a155447e95b820f76 still has only `authenticated && private`. The source ancestry is edeec965... -> eb3c367... -> 036421f... -> 4f91d94..., where 4f91d94d35563f9c5c02bf45e5a5ee1271290310 refines the predicate to private exposure. `git diff 4f91d94... 32a9165... -- server/src/app.ts server/src/__tests__/app-private-hostname-gate.test.ts` is empty, proving that 32a9165... lands the final source-branch fix, but `git show --stat 32a9165...` shows a 39-file GitHub squash containing unrelated issue/editor and wakeup work; it is therefore the landed fix, not the direct source commit. Both c92db0a... and the squash parent 50cd76d8a3f2fc06d1a5af63840abd3d7a1bcd02 retain the vulnerable authenticated-private-only gate. Version checks resolve the boundary: v0.3.1 peels to 63c62e3ada077bac45292f3d2779bd48a8831cda and contains the BIC but not the fix; `git for-each-ref --contains=32a9165... --sort=version:refname` identifies v2026.416.0, peeled commit b8725c52eff66cdea8cb223f1ca885475a254468, as the first stable v* tag containing the landed fix. Thus repository ancestry shows v0.3.1 remained vulnerable despite the advisory's syndicated range.
reasoning: The vulnerability-first result is unchanged: abadd469bc85e9fa5137ff5ffce433f1c2db2c0b first completed the unauthenticated browser-to-spawn chain, its direct parent lacks the completing paths, and its own commit object supplies direct Claude co-authorship evidence, so AI_ROOT_CAUSE is gate-complete. On the assigned fix_sha topic, the primary wins and the reviewer conflated two roles. edeec965f84e4376c42e93761823ff1b959a8302 is the earliest real source commit that changes the Host gate to cover local_trusted and makes the disclosed default private deployment reject a rebinding Host; the later 4f91d94d35563f9c5c02bf45e5a5ee1271290310 only narrows that already-effective change to private exposure. Commit 32a9165ddf6308f3b46eae0653b6f583e502e538 is still the correct fix_sha because it is the landed commit and the first fixed release ancestor, but it is a squash aggregate with additional unrelated changes and cannot also be the direct_fix_sha under the protocol's rejection of squash aggregates. The verified version ancestry, rather than the inconsistent advisory metadata, sets the actual fixed boundary at v2026.416.0.
